tasks.short: Coordinate and supervise clubs, student organisations and academic contests

steps.what: Coordinate extracurricular activity arrangements, participants and required supervision
Supervise clubs, student organisations or academic contests and support safe participation

tasks.design: Configure native shared activity entries and enrolment lists in {CALENDAR} and the existing {LMS} where supported. The teacher still captures requirements, checks permissions and confirms arrangements before communication; live supervision retains all time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity coordination can require repeated room, attendance and permission messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendars and lists can consolidate arrangements without deciding student eligibility.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring suitable supervision and responding to events during the activity.
tasks.human_edge: Support participation and resolve practical or interpersonal problems in the moment.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated coordination; activity and supervision responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Support an extracurricular session within agreed responsibilities
reach.learn: Activity instructions, participation needs and escalation

evidence.claim: Native calendars and enrolment lists can reduce coordination messaging without reducing live supervision.

assumptions: Boundary covers this teacher's coordination and supervision, not participants' time or organiser policy work. Related recreation or school supervision time is counted once.

The teacher produces purpose, date, duration, capacity, location and supervision requirements in retained s1 time. Room owners produce existing availability, while families or school administrators provide required permission status through the existing participation process, unchanged; retained s1 includes checking and manually resolving missing entries.
No permission or safe-supervision flag is inferred. Uncertain participation or conflicting availability requires manual contact before confirmation.
Test native scheduling and enrolment functions first. The teacher reviews and releases exact arrangements within retained s1 time, not in a hidden automated approval.
No pupil ranking, behavioural inference or automatic contest admission is introduced.
unknowns: Existing activity tools, permission route and actual coordination burden
research_questions: Does shared coordination reduce time after counting requirement entry and missing permissions?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, exception checks and final confirmation remain.

incremental.description: Teacher checks activity-list quality and recurring coordination rules.
School system owner maintains enrolment permissions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity date, location, supervision, participant list and required permissions checked before communication; changes require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12 less two focal upkeep hours gives net=10. High assumes coordination falls 40 percent; low assumes manual permissions and conflicts leave only upkeep-equivalent gain. Supervision keeps its full share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, order, store, issue and inventory classroom supplies and equipment

steps.what: Select classroom equipment, materials and supplies based on teaching needs and stock
Order selected classroom supplies within authorised purchasing limits
Receive, store and issue classroom equipment, materials and supplies
Count classroom inventory and identify stock discrepancies
Update classroom inventory records from checked counts and supply movements

tasks.design: Use native catalogue order reuse and stock records in {PROCUREMENT} before custom inventory tools. The teacher selects and approves the exact order, physically handles and counts supplies, then checks movement and count entries; no reorder is triggered from an assumed clean stock level.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ordering and inventory updates can involve repeated copying beside unavoidable physical handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchasing and stock fields can reuse approved item data and calculate ledger balances.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing suitable materials and explaining a mismatch between physical stock and the record.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an unsuitable substitute and investigate an unexplained shortage.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order and ledger entry; purchasing limits and physical work stay unchanged.

reach.task: Improve a shared materials issue record
reach.learn: Item identity, units and reconciliation of physical counts

evidence.claim: Native catalogue ordering and stock records can reduce repeated entry while retaining selection, handling and counts.

assumptions: Boundary covers teacher supplies work, not supplier delivery, purchasing approval beyond teacher limits or accounting payment. Those outside activities are unchanged.

The teacher produces item, quantity, unit and need-by date in s1. Purchasing owners maintain catalogue item, price and supplier terms outside this boundary with unchanged effort; retained s2 includes current-price, delivery and order checks. Requests beyond delegated limits follow the existing purchasing approval route.

The teacher captures item, movement type, quantity, unit, date and location during s3 and produces physical count and observed discrepancy in s4; their full capture and handling time remains. Retained s5 includes identity matching, manual entry and unresolved difference checks. No free par level, discrepancy code or perfect stock feed is assumed.
Missing item codes, mismatched units or unexplained counts use manual reconciliation and purchasing clarification, never automatic adjustment or reorder.
Test native purchasing functions first. The 15 percent gross saving is an E1 scenario for repeated entry, not physical work or existing system runtime.
unknowns: Purchasing authority, current stock tools and actual copying burden
research_questions: Does native order reuse and direct stock entry save time after all movement capture and reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Selection, physical handling and stock counting remain.
Order checking and authorised release remain.
Inventory field entry and reconciliation remain.

incremental.description: Teacher checks item mappings and recurring ledger differences.
Purchasing owner maintains extra catalogue and stock configuration.

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, items, quantities, units, prices, delivery terms and budget allocation reviewed before placing the order; any change requires renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15 less two focal upkeep hours gives net=13. High assumes order and ledger entry halve; low assumes current tools or reconciliation leave only upkeep-equivalent gains. Selection, handling and counts retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardised tests and interpret strengths and needs

steps.what: Administer standardized ability and achievement tests following approved procedures
Interpret standardized test results to determine student strengths and needs

tasks.design: Retain test administration and contextual interpretation, using the {OTHER} approved testing platform and guidance in {DOCS}. Existing scoring runtime is outside this labour estimate and earns no new saving; no model decides learning level or support needs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standardised scores need valid administration and context before interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Testing platforms can provide results without determining their educational meaning for a student.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising invalid conditions, measurement limits and differences from classroom evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Avoid overinterpreting a score and identify the next question to investigate.
tasks.altitude: Administration and support-interpretation responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a discrepancy between test results and classroom evidence

evidence.claim: Standardised test administration and contextual interpretation remain human work even when the approved platform scores responses.

assumptions: Boundary covers administration and interpretation, not redesigning the test, automated proctoring or formal placement. Publisher or platform scoring is existing outside work and unchanged.

The teacher checks identities and approved accommodations and produces administration observations in s1, retaining all capture time. The test provider produces version-bound results and guidance through the existing scoring process; missing or inconsistent results are clarified manually, not inferred.
Test native approved result views before custom additions; no new scoring, pupil-monitoring or outcome-evaluation model is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process is unchanged. Any formal support decision follows the existing school route.
unknowns: Approved testing platform, accommodation process and interpretation responsibilities
research_questions: Which administration conditions most often limit the validity of a result?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, net=0. Straightforward results and discrepancies with classroom evidence retain administration and interpretation; no existing scoring runtime is counted as saved labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan assignments, supervise and evaluate assistants and volunteers

steps.what: Plan assignments for teacher assistants and volunteers within their responsibilities
Supervise assistants and volunteers and provide guidance during their work
Evaluate assistants' or volunteers' work and discuss development or revised assignments

tasks.design: Retain assignment judgement, observation, guidance and evaluation with the teacher. Existing role instructions in {DOCS} can support clarity; this design introduces no automatic staff scoring or assignment by inferred traits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appropriate delegation depends on the person, activity and actual classroom conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Clear role information supports delegation without replacing supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a competence gap and giving constructive feedback without exceeding authority.
tasks.human_edge: Match an assignment to verified capability and respond to practice rather than an assumed score.
tasks.altitude: Delegation and evaluation rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the learning purpose and limits of an assigned activity

evidence.claim: Assistant and volunteer supervision requires contextual delegation, direct observation and feedback.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's assignment and supervision work, not assistants' delivery time or formal employment decisions.

The teacher establishes needs and verifies availability and role limits in s1, then produces supervision observations in s2; all capture and conversation are counted. No free competence profile or structured performance score is assumed.
Unclear capability or role limits require direct clarification and existing managerial escalation. Native role-information access is considered first; no new tool is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process remains unchanged. Supervision overlapping an activity task must be allocated once.
unknowns: Delegation limits and formal evaluation responsibilities
research_questions: Which assignment failures come from unclear expectations rather than scheduling or record access?

already_counted.description: Assignment planning, supervision and evaluation remain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, net=0. Routine delegation and developing staff capability retain planning, observation and feedback time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native activity coordination and supply records may reduce repeated entry. Physical handling, tests, supervision and staff evaluation retain their full human time.
reach: Support teaching assistants with clear activity responsibilities
Improve materials records with library technicians
Discuss test interpretation with special education teachers
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with clearer logistics and fewer repeated entries who still observes students and colleagues directly and retains educational judgement.

job.title: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
